payload.core_mechanism_summary: DP with 4 states tracks max length of pattern (1s, 2s, 1s, 2s) to compute LNDS after one reversal, using prefix and suffix sums.
payload.rationale: The solution iterates forward updating 4 DP values based on a[i]==1 or 2, capturing optimal subsequence shape after reversal. This is a 1D DP with constant states.
